h:
快速将图像和音乐变成完美同步的舞蹈视频。

适合谁：希望在 ComfyUI 中使用此管道而无需从头开始组装节点的创建者。不适合：零调整的一键结果 - 您仍然可以选择输入、提示和设置。

在 RunComfy 上打开预加载的工作流程

在 RunComfy（浏览器）上打开预加载的工作流程

为什么首先选择 RunComfy
- 更少的丢失节点意外- 在本地镜像之前，在托管环境中运行该图。
- GPU 快速试用- 如果您的本地 VRAM 或安装时间是瓶颈，则非常有用。
- 与发布的 JSON 匹配- 该 zip 遵循与您可以在 RunComfy 上打开的相同的可运行工作流程。

当下载本地 ComfyUI 有意义时- 您想要完全控制磁盘上的模型、批处理脚本或离线运行。

使用方法（本地ComfyUI）
1. 在标记的加载器节点中加载输入（图像/视频/音频）。
2、设置提示、分辨率、种子；从短暂的试运行开始。
3. 从图中所示的保存/写入节点导出。

期望- 第一次运行可能会拉动大重量;云运行可能需要免费的 RunComfy 帐户.

概述

这种音乐驱动的动画工作流程可帮助您将任何静止图像转换为与配乐完美同步的舞蹈表演。您可以微调动作幅度、身体协调性和舞蹈风格，以实现创造性的灵活性。它以 Wan-Dancer-14B 模型为基础，平衡了全局结构与详细的局部运动。非常适合制作社交媒体剪辑、舞蹈演示或概念动画测试的创作者。精确的节奏对齐确保每一帧中的自然、富有表现力的动作。

重要节点：

Comfyui Wan Dancer工作流程中的关键节点

定制组合（舞蹈风格）（#695）

选择插入全局和本地文本提示中的舞蹈类别。选择与您的曲目流派相匹配的风格以获得最佳效果，或将您自己的条目添加到列表中。如果动作看起来与节拍不匹配，请在调整其他控件之前尝试具有更清晰节奏重音的风格。

自定义组合（运动幅度）（#694）

控制编舞的活力程度。较低的值可以抑制轻柔音乐的运动；较高的值会增加能量轨道的行程和肢体速度。如果您发现极端姿势中的身份漂移或伪影，请将幅度减小一步并重新预览。

WanDancerEncodeAudio（#651）

将修剪后的音乐编码为全局通行证的节奏和强度特征。这会驱动内部节拍对齐万舞者视频（＃647）。对于非常柔和的前奏或长淡入淡出，请考虑修剪到具有清晰节拍的部分，以帮助编码器快速锁定。

万舞者视频（#647）

以选定的分辨率和序列长度综合文本、图像和音频特征的全局编排。将其视为运动规划器：在继续之前，在此处验证时间、风格和一般姿势动态。如果预览的色度噪声太大，请继续；颜色保真度在本地通道中得到固化。

WanDancerPad关键帧列表（#670）

从全局输出构建关键帧时间线并将其与所选持续时间对齐。这确保本地通道能够看到视觉锚点和正确的音频片段。如果延长持续时间，该节点会平滑地填充间隙，以便本地模型可以干净地进行插值。

WanDancerEncodeAudio（#669）

在关键帧填充后重新编码音频以适应本地帧预算。这使得精致的动作与音乐锁相。更改剪辑长度时，请始终运行此节点，以便本地模型听到正确的片段。

o.en:
Turns image and music into perfectly synced dance videos fast.

Who it's for:creators who want this pipeline in ComfyUI without assembling nodes from scratch.Not for:one-click results with zero tuning - you still choose inputs, prompts, and settings.

Open preloaded workflow on RunComfy

Open preloaded workflow on RunComfy (browser)

Why RunComfy first
- Fewer missing-node surprises- run the graph in a managed environment before you mirror it locally.
- Quick GPU tryout- useful if your local VRAM or install time is the bottleneck.
- Matches the published JSON- the zip follows the same runnable workflow you can open on RunComfy.

When downloading for local ComfyUI makes sense- you want full control over models on disk, batch scripting, or offline runs.

How to use (local ComfyUI)
1. Load inputs (images/video/audio) in the marked loader nodes.
2. Set prompts, resolution, and seeds; start with a short test run.
3. Export from the Save / Write nodes shown in the graph.

Expectations- First run may pulllarge weights; cloud runs may require afree RunComfy account.

Overview

This music-driven animation workflow helps you transform any still image into a dance performance perfectly synced with your soundtrack. You can fine-tune motion amplitude, body coordination, and dance style for creative flexibility. Built on Wan-Dancer-14B models, it balances global structure with detailed local movement. Ideal for creators making social media clips, dance demos, or conceptual animation tests. Precision rhythm alignment ensures natural, expressive motion in every frame.

Important nodes:

Key nodes in Comfyui Wan Dancer workflow

Custom Combo (Dance Style)(#695)

Selects the dance category that gets inserted into both the global and local text prompts. Choose a style that matches your track’s genre for best results, or add your own entries to the list. If the motion looks mismatched to the beat, try a style with clearer rhythmic accents before adjusting other controls.

Custom Combo (Motion Amplitude)(#694)

Controls how energetic the choreography should be. Lower values keep motion contained for gentle music; higher values increase travel and limb velocity for energetic tracks. If you notice identity drift or artifacts in extreme poses, reduce amplitude one step and re‑preview.

WanDancerEncodeAudio(#651)

Encodes the trimmed music into rhythm and intensity features for the global pass. This drives beat alignment insideWanDancerVideo(#647). For very soft intros or long fades, consider trimming to the section with a clear beat to help the encoder lock on quickly.

WanDancerVideo(#647)

Synthesizes the global choreography from text, image, and audio features at the chosen resolution and sequence length. Treat this as a motion planner: verify timing, style, and general pose dynamics here before moving on. If the preview is too chroma‑noisy, keep going; color fidelity is solidified in the local pass.

WanDancerPadKeyframesList(#670)

Builds a timeline of keyframes from the global output and aligns them to the chosen duration. This ensures the local pass sees both visual anchors and the correct audio segment. If you extend duration, this node fills gaps smoothly so the local model can interpolate cleanly.

WanDancerEncodeAudio(#669)

Re‑encodes audio for the local frame budget after keyframe padding. This keeps the refined motion phase‑locked to the music. When changing clip length, always run this node so the local model hears the correct segment.
